title: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. translated_title: 面向连续扩散语言模型的Transformer架构设计
translated_abstract: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）为并行语言生成提供了一种替代方法；然而，现有研究大多直接使用来自因果大语言模型（LLM）或图像生成领域的扩散Transformer（DiT）的Transformer架构，而这些架构并未针对CDLM进行优化。本文对适用于CDLM的Transformer架构进行了系统性研究，并提出语言扩散Transformer（LangDiT），其融合了特征与查询-键归一化、更宽的噪声条件化机制、似然捷径梯度路由与校准，以及基于置信度门控的训练阶段自条件化。在匹配的LangFlow对比实验中，LangDiT显著降低了生成困惑度，在不同模型形式下确立了连续语言生成的新技术水平。以LangFlow作为代表性CDLM，LangDiT作为即插即用的骨干网络，构建出新的最先进模型（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文系统研究了适用于连续扩散语言模型的Transformer架构，提出LangDiT，通过特征与查询-键归一化、宽噪声条件化、似然捷径梯度路由与置信度门控自条件化等设计，显著降低生成困惑度，在连续语言生成领域建立了新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies Transformer architectures for continuous diffusion language models and proposes LangDiT, which combines feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning, significantly reducing generation perplexity and establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation.
